asset.description: the vehicle/plant the snapshot is about; the shelf's only required coordinate

device.description: the telematics unit that produced the reading, distinct from the asset identity

distance_period.description: distance accumulated over the reading window (delta, not a lifetime meter)

engine_hours_period.description: engine hours accumulated over the reading window

financial_period.description: the accounting period the snapshot falls in; derived, no raw source field

fuel_period.description: fuel consumed over the reading window

last_event_type.description: the discriminator for what the last event was (type/subtype), for a state snapshot

occurred_at.description: when the last event on the unit happened; the shelf's temporal coordinate

operator.description: the driver/operator active on the unit

place_label.description: the human-readable location text delivered by the source

readings_at.description: when the meter readings were taken, distinct from the last-event time

source_system.description: which bound system emitted the snapshot

trip.description: the source trip/journey the last event belongs to
